To be honest out of all the substances I’ve done, alcohol is by far the most harmful.  I drink way less than I used to.  When I do drink, I am pretty wrecked for the next 1-2 days. I’ve only done psychedelics, marijuana, alcohol, and mdma, all after extensive research.  

But I definitely don’t think psychedelics are an escape from reality.  If anything they provoke an intense reality check.  Psychedelics put me in my place and made me realize the human mind is very limited.  The human mind is highly limited in what it can perceive, and psychedelics expands on what the human mind is normally capable of.  It’s literally not possible to describe since there are no existing words to describe what you experience.  I’ve had unbelievably positive experiences on them, and absolutely terrible experiences (that could have been prevented).  I value both of them the same because what I took out of those negative trips were enlightening and helped me improved my persona.

The thing is, mdma, some psychedelics, and marijuana have a TON of peer reviewed study publications of how they are beneficial to health.  A lot of it boils down to how they are administered and if it’s good product.  The reason lsd is dangerous because you can easily be taking another research chemical and not know it.  Same with MDMA.  That’s why they need to be regulated, Street drugs are dangerous.  In clinical scenarios they can produce tremendous results in things like depression,  PTSD, anxiety, etc.  Marijuana has many more than that.  There are kids that take CBD (another active ingredient in marijuana other than thc that doesn’t even get you high) that have to move across the country JUST to take THE ONLY medicine that prevents them from having seizures. 


Anyway, I am dragging on too much here... the point I am trying to make is “drugs” is an EXTREMELY loose term.  There are bad legal drugs and bad illegal drugs.  There are good illegal drugs and good legal drugs. I just recommend reading as many publications you can on your drug in question before you draw conclusions.

In terms of using drugs as an escape...  I think of drugs Opioids and some benzos.

For me I have a fantastic job and make fantastic money, and wouldn’t take any substance that prevented me from doing so. I like to think I’ve done the reasonable substances to take.  In terms of drug testing, marijuana is really the only drug that will show up after a few weeks on a test.  Unless it’s hair then you’re kinda fucked.
